name: Thread the Needle
summary: On hands and knees, open one arm to the ceiling then thread it under the body.
steps: Breathe in to reach one arm up to the ceiling, chest turning open.
Breathe out to thread that arm under the body, shoulder and ear lowering towards the mat.

layers.title: Open to the ceiling
layers.text: Follow the hand with the eyes.

layers.title: Thread under
layers.text: Shoulder and ear come to the mat.

layers.title: Hold the twist
layers.text: Two breaths threaded, pressing the mat away with the other hand.

cues:
Hips stay over the knees.
Push the floor away with the supporting hand.
Turn from the ribs.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Forearm down on the supporting side
